sections.heading: Change the phone number or job title on a profile
sections.text: Users can update their phone number, job title, and display name from Profile > Contact Details. The sign-in email address cannot be changed by the user.

steps.text: Ask the user to open Profile > Contact Details and select Edit.
Ask the user to update the phone number, job title, or display name and select Save.

stop_conditions.text: If the user needs to change the sign-in email address, stop and escalate to L2; email changes require identity verification.
